title: A comment thread card whose newest message is taller than its list opens at that message's top (author line in view)
steps: S1: In vendor/tracy/dsh-better-sidebar run the vitest file tests/comment-people-layer.spec.tsx, filtered to 'the newest message taller than the list'.
expect: S1: one message on an element taller than the frame ("On body", card capped to THREAD_CARD_MIN): the message's top edge is not above the list's top edge (its face and author line are in view).
S1: a four-message thread whose newest reply is taller than the list: the list stands at that reply's top, scrolled past the earlier messages.
evidence: Measured on dev 09/10/2026 (account-menu acceptance hc-faces-hca-pin2.jpg): a 160px card On body showed only the lower half of the author's face; the list was aimed at scrollHeight

cmd: the newest message taller than the list
